'''Brocky''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Brocky appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Republic vendor in the Quesh Warzone which first appeared in Update 2.7.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
